title: Terminal Deck
direction: Full-window terminal workspace, host hierarchy on the left and delivery decisions in a right sidebar.
tokens: Neutral graphite and porcelain, muted blue selection, system sans-serif chrome, monospace terminal text, 4px spacing scale.
proposed: Supervisor request records, structured workflow and command receipts require a durable host service and CLI/MCP adapters; v4 simulates them in browser memory only.
Working, disconnected and no-output previews are available by scenario query parameter; real states require structured runtime events.
Four sessions use equal 2x2 panes; three sessions use equal columns.
Terminal text scaling up to 200% is proposed from Apple HIG guidance; browser accessibility still needs validation.
The source's layout presets are omitted from application chrome; production placement is undecided.
notes: v4 adds supervisor requests, workflow state, a command/response history and an instruction composer to the right sidebar. Approval waits for a supervisor acknowledgement; demo submission means locally queued, not delivered. Keeps full-window layout, host hierarchy and remote supervisor fixture. HIG hierarchy and disclosure guidance comes from Docify apple-his@1.0.0. All exchanges are synthetic; no live backend, MCP, Ghostty or PTY is connected.
